name: home-glass-night
refs: THE PICTURE TO EDIT (the vivarium by day: keep everything, change only the light and the air):
THE LIGHT TO MATCH (the signed night painting of the same place from afar: its dark quiet background, its warm ground band and its small glow pools; not its composition):
prompt: Output a NEW image: the same vivarium picture at NIGHT: a dark, quiet background and a warm readable ground. The background and the canopy (everything above the ground band) are DARK and quiet, a deep warm umber-olive, desaturated, no amber haze, the depth reads dark. The ground band where the creatures walk is warm and readable, a clear mid-dark warm tone, with the moss, stones and soil legible. Only small LOCAL pools of warm glow: a few small glowing patches of glow-moss and a few tiny glowing mushrooms on the ground, nothing glowing in the background. The moon only a very faint, thin pale cool rim on a few upper leaf edges. Nothing blue anywhere else, nothing green-daylit, no wide amber haze. Keep the picture EXACTLY the same in composition and content: the same burrow, pool, stones, roots, moss, feed line at the left, mister and vent at the right, plants and the same plain dark soil along the bottom, in the same places and sizes, the same matte sculpted miniature rendering; change ONLY the lighting, its colour and the air. Still NO creatures, no text, no letters, no digits, no frame, no glossy surfaces, no neon.
